about: The steam off the hob: a jet out of the boiling kettle's spout and a gentle rise off the simmering pot, both on the hob whose coils glow under them. Every number is this record's, after real kettles and pans. Frame: the CrewHabitat node's own.

effects.name: kettle_steam
effects.from: footage: flickr-5587696584, commons-boilingkettle, arxiv-2201.12128 (a boiling kettle's turbulent jet out of its spout (the mesh's farthest point from its middle above half its height, toward +z), clear for its first 1.5 to 4.5 cm where the steam is still too hot to condense, then white as it mixes with the room's air, rising and widening, drying away within half a metre)

effects.name: pot_steam
effects.from: footage: flickr-4276025236, commons-steam-asparagus (a simmering pot's steam rising slowly off its whole top (its rim 3.5 cm under the box's top, at the lid's handle) and curling as it cools, gone about 0.05 to 0.12 m over the rim at a simmer)

no_light: fog, ice and steam give off no light of their own; the place's lamps light them

footage.how: Measured on each photograph's pixels against a thing of known size in it (named with each source; a typical size where the maker's own was not looked up, so to roughly a third), or read off a report's text. A plume running off the frame bounds a measure on one side only (null). The seconds are the place's own: when its motion record runs the pump and opens the door.

arxiv-2201.12128.what: a review of whistling kettles, its figure 25a a schlieren picture of a kettle's jet by Settles (arXiv 2201.12128)
arxiv-2201.12128.measured: looked at on the photograph and measured on its pixels, against the kettle's width: the hot jet about 7 degrees either side over at least 1.7 kettle widths (the gas, not the steam one sees); no length, gap or speed in the text

commons-boilingkettle.what: a glass electric kettle boiling (Wikimedia Commons Boilingkettle.jpg, CC BY-SA 4.0)
commons-boilingkettle.measured: looked at on the photograph and measured on its pixels, against the kettle's height (about 0.25 m, 1505 px): clear for about 4.5 cm, at least 9 cm of plume before the frame's edge, about 20 degrees either side

commons-steam-asparagus.what: a pot of asparagus steaming (Wikimedia Commons Steam-boiling_green_asparagus.jpg, CC0)
commons-steam-asparagus.measured: looked at on the photograph and measured on its pixels, against the rim (about 0.18 m): faint wisps up to about half the rim's width over it, about 0.1 m

flickr-4276025236.what: an open pot steaming on a hob (Flickr 4276025236, CC BY 2.0)
flickr-4276025236.measured: looked at on the photograph and measured on its pixels, against the rim (about 0.20 m, 407 px): faint wisps about 6 cm over the rim, about 0.11 m wide

flickr-5587696584.what: a whistling kettle boiling on a stove (Flickr 5587696584, CC BY 2.0)
flickr-5587696584.measured: looked at on the photograph and measured on its pixels, against the lid's knob (about 3.5 cm, 75 px): clear for about 1.5 cm at the spout, the jet at least 0.20 to 0.27 m, running off the frame, about 10 degrees either side, leaning about 37 degrees off upright
